horizon: Endpoint at one year (365.25 days) after implementation at 2026 technology, with stated implementation ramps; 6/36-month sensitivity paths supplied; average-year research inputs explicitly identified
estimand: Difference in endpoint U.S.–China capability gap on a fixed U.S. progress ruler, policy vs otherwise without the covered requirement; voluntary baseline retained
distribution_note: Triangular low/high are elicited scenario bounds, NOT confidence intervals. Calibrated ranges are analyst distributions around cited observations. Source_ids on analyst priors identify context only and do not empirically establish the number.

sources.title: CAISI’s Assessment of Z.ai’s GLM-5.3 Cyber Capabilities
numerical_evidence: About four months behind the U.S. frontier on a composite cyber evaluation.
sources.limitation: Public and trusted-access models only; explicitly excludes unreleased internal models. General/private gap prior is an extrapolation, not this observation.

sources.title: Will Huawei catch up to Nvidia by 2030?
numerical_evidence: 2026 forecast: Nvidia 23 million H100-equivalents; Huawei 0.88 million.
Huawei chip-count forecast 1.5 million; Nvidia 5.9 million.
sources.limitation: Forecast and hardware-rated throughput, not deployed frontier compute or causal effect of removing controls.

sources.title: Introducing the AI Chip Owners Explorer
numerical_evidence: End-2025 Chinese ownership just over 5% of global rated compute.
Google about 5 million H100e and 25% of world total, implying world about 20 million and China about 1 million H100e.
sources.limitation: Rounded derivation. Excludes smuggling and offshore rentals. Does not establish September 2026 stock.

sources.title: Trade data is consistent with more than $3 billion of chips smuggled into China via Malaysia
numerical_evidence: April 2024–June 2025: China records $3.8bn server imports against Malaysia $0.6bn exports.
Rough compute equivalent 150,000 H100e; alternative chip mix can reduce this to 50,000.
sources.limitation: Consistent with diversion, not proof or an exhaustive smuggling estimate.

sources.title: DeepSeek-R1: Incentivizing Reasoning Capability in LLMs via Reinforcement Learning
numerical_evidence: Table 6: Qwen-32B distilled versus RL-only: AIME 72.6 vs 47.0; GPQA 62.1 vs 55.0; LiveCodeBench 57.2 vs 40.2.
sources.limitation: Domestic DeepSeek teacher and small students, not foreign-model dependence. No equal-total-cost causal conversion to national progress.

sources.title: Distillation Scaling Laws
sources.limitation: Provides teacher/student scaling method, not a Chinese dependence fraction or intervention efficacy.

sources.title: Detecting and preventing distillation attacks
numerical_evidence: Over 16 million exchanges through approximately 24,000 fraudulent accounts attributed to three labs.
sources.limitation: Detected use is not causal capability uplift; selective detection and interested provider.

sources.title: Securing AI Model Weights: Preventing Theft and Misuse of Frontier Models
numerical_evidence: 38 attack vectors and five security levels.
sources.limitation: No empirically identified annual frontier theft hazard or risk-reduction fraction.

sources.title: Improving our alignment and security practices
numerical_evidence: About 150 product engineers temporarily reassigned; researchers also rotated; most teams finished by early summer.
A separate production RL-environment freeze lasted roughly one month.
sources.limitation: Voluntary baseline; whole-company security/reliability/privacy campaign, not the marginal mandate cost or whole-frontier slowdown.

sources.title: Personnel Vetting: Leadership Attention Needed to Prioritize System Development and Achieve Reforms, GAO-26-108838
numerical_evidence: FY2025 Q2 fastest 90% of initial Top Secret cases averaged 206 days; goal 114 days.
sources.limitation: Government processing is an analogue for near-clearance vetting, not lab-specific delay. GAO also reports significant underlying timeliness-data reliability issues.

sources.title: Building a Wall Around Science: The Effect of U.S.-China Tensions on International Scientific Research
sources.date: 2024 conference version; NBER June 2024 revised October 2024
numerical_evidence: Version inspected: ethnic-Chinese entrants 15% less likely to attend U.S. PhD; graduates 4% less likely to remain; U.S.-based researcher productivity 2–6% lower.
sources.limitation: Different population, treatment and horizon; later revisions differ. Context for priors, not a clearance-policy causal coefficient.

sources.title: Checkr's background check process
sources.limitation: Commercial service claim; actual start-date delay can be zero due to overlap and existing checks.

sources.title: SL5 Standard for AI Security
sources.limitation: Long-lead security design, no measured productivity penalty or proven theft elimination.

sources.title: Oversight for Frontier AI through a Know-Your-Customer Scheme for Compute Providers
sources.limitation: KYC enables oversight and enforcement; does not estimate denial rate or offshore Chinese frontier share.

sources.title: Securing Technological Leadership? The Cost of Export Controls on Firms
numerical_evidence: Reports $130bn decline in affected U.S. suppliers’ market capitalization and weaker firm outcomes.
sources.limitation: Not a current AI-accelerator R&D or frontier-speed elasticity.

shared_security_inputs.name: relevant_asset_gap_days
shared_security_inputs.units: days on root fixed U.S. capability ruler
shared_security_inputs.rationale: Root-compatible current gap prior: 120-day low anchored in CAISI public/trusted-access cyber comparison; 180-day mode and 300-day high allow general-capability and private-asset differences. Not an observed national or internal lead.

shared_security_inputs.name: annual_useful_frontier_compromise_probability
shared_security_inputs.units: probability across covered U.S. frontier assets in one year
shared_security_inputs.rationale: Probability under current voluntary safeguards that at least one stolen frontier artifact becomes available to a Chinese frontier actor. Selected as a low-frequency but material strategic risk; not inferred from counts of published incidents.

shared_security_inputs.name: insider_hazard_share
shared_security_inputs.rationale: Insiders remain one path among remote compromise and supply-chain/physical compromise. Draw once for all security policies.

shared_security_inputs.name: other_nonremote_hazard_share
shared_security_inputs.units: fraction of hazard remaining after insiders
shared_security_inputs.rationale: Physical and supply-chain routes are retained after classifying insider routes. Remote share=(1-insider)*(1-other_nonremote).

shared_security_inputs.name: compromise_gap_fraction_recovered
shared_security_inputs.units: fraction of current relevant U.S.–China capability gap recovered conditional on usable theft
shared_security_inputs.rationale: A usable frontier artifact may convey much but not all deployable capability. Does not assume entire national innovation capability is transferred. Multiply by root benchmark-specific gap, not a hardcoded number of days.

shared_security_inputs.name: compromise_absorption_days
shared_security_inputs.units: calendar days from compromise to useful deployment
shared_security_inputs.rationale: Architecture, infrastructure, inference budget and validation prevent assuming instantaneous full use. This is operational absorption time, not a desired final policy effect.

shared_security_inputs.name: compromise_advantage_half_life_days
shared_security_inputs.rationale: Conditional theft advantage decays as counterfactual independent progress, model obsolescence and diffusion catch up. No direct estimate. Keeps a first-year endpoint benefit distinct from a one-time value at theft.

shared_security_inputs.name: security_rollout_fraction_year
shared_security_inputs.units: share of first year during which mature controls operate
shared_security_inputs.rationale: One-time implementation ramp. If root explicitly chooses mature steady state use 1 instead. Common draw across related controls.

diffusion_inputs.name: public_research_substitution_recovery
diffusion_inputs.units: fraction of unavailable U.S. research value recovered independently or elsewhere
diffusion_inputs.rationale: Separate gross research exposure from irreducible reliance. Conditional on scope of the public research channel.

diffusion_inputs.name: teacher_substitution_recovery
diffusion_inputs.units: fraction of unavailable frontier-teacher value recovered from other teachers/data/self-training
diffusion_inputs.rationale: Shared between anti-distillation and public-release withholding; do not draw or apply a second independent substitution discount.

diffusion_inputs.name: public_research_channel_share
diffusion_inputs.units: fraction of annual Chinese algorithmic knowledge additions before substitution
diffusion_inputs.rationale: Tentative decomposition of algorithmic knowledge additions, not fraction of all national capability progress. Public methods can transfer relatively quickly; independent discoveries remain substantial.

diffusion_inputs.name: frontier_teacher_channel_share
diffusion_inputs.units: fraction of annual Chinese algorithmic knowledge additions before substitution
diffusion_inputs.rationale: Positive mode reflects demonstrated distillation usefulness and observed foreign-output collection. Wide range reflects absent causal attribution.

diffusion_inputs.name: released_weights_channel_share
diffusion_inputs.units: fraction of annual Chinese algorithmic knowledge additions before substitution
diffusion_inputs.rationale: Released weights support inference, fine-tuning and research; 2026 Chinese teachers provide important substitutes.

diffusion_inputs.name: researcher_transfer_channel_share
diffusion_inputs.units: fraction of annual Chinese algorithmic knowledge additions before substitution
diffusion_inputs.rationale: Tacit research knowledge transfer; excludes labor added by separately modeled migration.

diffusion_inputs.name: public_research_absorption_days
diffusion_inputs.rationale: Public algorithm findings require implementation and replication.

diffusion_inputs.name: teacher_data_absorption_days
diffusion_inputs.rationale: Collecting, filtering and retraining on teacher data imposes operational lag.

diffusion_inputs.name: released_weights_absorption_days
diffusion_inputs.rationale: Deployable weights normally need less replication than research findings.

policies.name: Advanced chip export controls
policies.counterfactual: Maintain the frozen site’s advanced-accelerator and manufacturing-input restrictions for 12 months versus relaxing those covered restrictions at the start; current stock, voluntary practices, unrelated sanctions, and non-U.S. export decisions remain. China purchases and deployments ramp, not instant parity.

inputs.name: nvidia_annual_output_h100e
inputs.units: million rated H100e/year
inputs.rationale: Mode equals published 2026 forecast; interval is our predictive uncertainty, not the paper’s confidence interval. Hold 2026 output pace for this exercise.

inputs.name: incremental_china_purchase_share
inputs.units: fraction of Nvidia annual output additional to purchases allowed in baseline
inputs.rationale: Net incremental access after relaxing covered controls. One-tenth mode reflects strong demand but U.S. contracted allocation and Chinese budgets; deliberately below unconstrained parity. Existing permitted purchases are not recounted.

inputs.name: deployment_lag_days
inputs.units: calendar days
inputs.rationale: Ordering, delivery, power and commissioning prevent immediate use. Includes supplying HBM/equipment pathway lag.

inputs.name: usable_fraction_of_added_rated_compute
inputs.units: fraction
inputs.rationale: Allows for provisioning, interconnect, utilization and imperfect substitution into relevant training/inference workloads.

inputs.name: extra_domestic_output_after_relaxation
inputs.units: million rated H100e delivered in first year
inputs.rationale: Additional domestic chip output from newly available manufacturing inputs. Small first-year mode because fabs cannot be rebuilt instantly; final-chip imports are faster.

inputs.name: baseline_china_average_usable_compute
inputs.units: million H100e during next 12 months
inputs.rationale: End-2025 owned stock near 1m plus 2026 output, illicit imports, rentals and further build-out; 3m is an analyst extrapolation, not a reported current stock. Broad upper accommodates substantial unobserved access.

inputs.name: endpoint_to_average_compute_ratio
inputs.units: ratio of end-year stock to average stock over first year
inputs.rationale: Growing baseline stock; use baseline_average times this factor for endpoint compute changes. Share draw across U.S. and China as a simple trend scenario.

inputs.name: share_relevant_to_frontier_progress
inputs.units: fraction of country-level marginal compute increase available to frontier production
inputs.rationale: Not all additional chips serve frontier research or change a binding constraint. Avoids treating all national compute as a frontier cluster.

inputs.name: redirected_share_to_us_under_controls
inputs.units: fraction of prevented China sales deployed by U.S. users instead
inputs.rationale: Current supply allocation could redirect rather than destroy sales. This is a small positive U.S. resource effect of maintaining controls.

inputs.name: baseline_us_average_usable_compute
inputs.units: million H100e during next 12 months
inputs.rationale: Rough 2026 installed/allocated stock extrapolation. Wider than ownership evidence; only scales redirection term.

inputs.name: supplier_innovation_loss_us
inputs.units: fraction of U.S. research-equivalent input over first year
inputs.rationale: Revenue constraints may reduce upstream innovation, but near-term supply-constrained sales and long R&D lags make a small first-year mode appropriate. Not imported from market capitalization loss.

formulas: AUTHORITATIVE PATH: solve k/(1-exp(-k))=endpoint_to_average_compute_ratio; C0=baseline_china_average_usable_compute*k/expm1(k)>0; Cbase(t)=C0*exp(k*t), with t in years
Compute ratios enter both the direct frontier training channel and the root research-compute production function, where the latter contributes only additional algorithmic progress.
policies.narrative: Price present restrictions relative to specified relaxation, not versus a historically never-restricted China. Nominal H100e is an imperfect common unit. The largest uncertainty is incremental purchases and frontier relevance, not the measured chip-generation gap.
policies.point_estimate_instruction: Use root engine expected net lead effect, integrating joint draws. Mode-input outputs are an auditable illustration and need not equal the expectation or median. No desired final number of days is an input.

policies.name: Know-your-customer rules for compute providers

Primary case includes enforcement of already-applicable restrictions when new identification reveals ineligible access; identity-only sensitivity sets denial_after_detection=0.

inputs.rationale: Physical security helps some paths while hardware/supply-chain vulnerabilities remain.

security_aggregation.formula: lambda0=-ln(1-p0)/365.25. For each route r, lambda_r=lambda0*share_r; multiply route hazard by surviving mature-control factors after rollout onset. Integrate most-recent useful theft density lambda(u)*exp(-integral_u^cutoff lambda(v)dv), times retained conditional value exp(-decay*(cutoff-u)); cutoff=endpoint-absorption. Compare expected retained uplift once, policy vs baseline. Conditional value=gap_fraction*(asset_gap_days/365.25)*g_total. First-event calculation is diagnostic only.
overlap_rules: Light vetting is nested inside personnel security: when both selected, use the larger insider effect, not their sum or product.

For same technical remote/physical controls, weight security is nested inside secure-dev-env: use maximum route reduction for overlapping exposures; any demonstrably separate control may multiply residual hazard only.
Personnel security and technical controls may multiply residual insider hazard because detection and exfiltration are distinct stages, but sensitivity should use maximum to reflect correlation.
The baseline useful-compromise probability already conditions on voluntary safeguards and useful attacker access; do not multiply by an extra arbitrary probability of China using it.
Apply current relevant gap fraction once, not once per policy. Bound benefit by joint stolen-asset counterfactual.

diffusion_aggregation.normalization: If sampled knowledge-channel shares sum above 0.9, proportionally rescale them to 0.9; independent contribution is remaining share. Do not use as shares of all capability growth without an algorithmic contribution factor.
marginal_reliance_formulas: release_withholding_CN_target_log_effect=phi_T*(-g_total*release_delay_days/365.25); apply root diffusion lag, and do not discount substitution again
notes: Model teacher controls conditional on teacher availability; combine delays/access probabilities rather than summing whole teacher benefits.
Keep public papers, API teachers, released weights and theft distinct. The global slider should scale appropriate channel shares, not add a second spillover credit.
Weights or offshore chips may substitute for API knowledge; report sensitivity rather than assume independent policy effects.

vector_path_api.security_default: Most-recent useful theft, capped at one retained relevant-gap transfer; first-event diagnostic is not used for pricing
vector_path_api.compute_ratios: Physical resource channels only (export/KYC), including same frontier-relevance adjustment as direct effect; suitable for research capital input
vector_path_api.labor_ratios: Effective research labor input, not aggregated research output; constant first-year-average proxy for longer horizons

time_conversion_boundary: Root converts research inputs through country research-production elasticities, compute changes through capability production, and conditional theft gain through benchmark-specific gap and absorption. Do not multiply every percentage by 365 independently or apply two time conversions.
